entries.en: This is it.
My armor. This is what I was looking for.
I can't believe my ancestors ever wore this piece of crap, but at least I've got it back
That's the scum. Let's finish him.
This is the place. My armor's here somewhere.
I know who runs this place.
No, but I was planning to come here before you and I met.
This place belongs to a turian scum named Tonn Actus.
It's a long story, but he's got something that belongs to me.
Family armor. It's been with us for over five generations.
Turian military took it from my father's father after the war.
Somehow this ass wound up with it. I want it back.
Have you been here before?
Whatever. Let's get moving.
Well, what is it?
We'll get it back. Now let's move.
How do you know?
He took something?
Right with you.
I might just be starting to like you, Shepard.
Then I guess we're done here.
I'm glad we could help you get it back.
Uh-huh. Let's move, people.
That's great.
That's it, right? We can leave?
"Join the marines. See the galaxy." Hell.
Wake me up if I'm gonna get eaten.
There ain't any pirates here anyway.
Guess we won't be leaving, huh?
I wish you were a tank brigade. No offense.
I say we get the hell out of here.
I ain't slept in... uh... a long time.
You got any extra ammo, ma'am?
You got any extra ammo, sir?
You're a hell of a soldier.
Actually, we need to get the hell out of here. But I guess your ship couldn't carry us all.
Damned if I know, Commander.
They dropped us here a few months back. We get supplies every couple weeks. We didn't see anything local that was more dangerous than lichen.
Yesterday, these animals started coming out of the ground. No idea where they're from. This is what's left out of 90 men. I'm the ranking officer.
Never heard of them. Can't say I care.
There's been a lot of pirate activity in this cluster. We set up a chain of listening posts in the local systems, in case they have a staging base.
That wasn't all they have left. Not by a long shot.
Uh, actually, that wasn't the immediate problem.
What we just fought was a probe. Our seismic sensors are picking up a crapload more on their way up from underground. We've got five minutes, tops.
We might be able to hold them off if we were at peak. But you can see the fighting's busted this place up.
You heard the woman!
You heard the man!
Everybody pool magazines and grenades. Take a leak and a drink while you can. And if anyone wants a smoke, it's as good a time as any.
We're good, Commander.
If you go after that hive, watch your back.
Holy hell, ma'am.
Holy hell, sir.
Talk about a near-run thing. You all right?
Heh. Around here, they're more likely to find you.
Still on my feet. But we've been fighting for almost 26 hours straight. None of us will be standing for long.
Ma'am? We're getting a signal from one of the ground-scan UAVs. A big hollow space about five hundred meters under the surface.
Right. That must be it.
That must be where they're coming from. My people aren't in any condition for a clearing operation, though.
You don't have to do that, Commander. We've bled them. We can probably hold until a bigger ship arrives to get us offworld.
Understood, Commander. I wasn't asking. We'll hold until an evac ship arrives.
